title: Answer: a self is a pattern, not a physical object

statements.text: An observer is not a physical object in some universe but its observer state, abstract structure that cannot be created or destroyed. Whether an agent is one or many, as in teleportation or copying, is fundamentally meaningless: an agent is the equivalence class of all realizations of its self state.

sources.quote: an “observer” is not a physical object in some universe, but it is its observer state
the agent should think of itself as the equivalence class of all these realizations
